method.classification_rule: A rejection is semantic only when validate_fixture reports an error other than the final exact expected-fixture equality check.

canonical_favorable_invalid_paths.description: The fixed R2 public N-API baseline names start_resident and get_resident_status, while the sealed Rust source exports execute_command, execute_query, claim_outbox, acknowledge_outbox and reconcile.
candidate:intent:1 is revision 1 with a non-null predecessor belonging to another candidate_id, contrary to the fixed schema-v2 genesis predicate and predecessor foreign key.
The graph derives Command and request fingerprints from simplified invented objects rather than the sealed ten-field Command plus authentication assertion and six-field NAPI request frame.
